report.explanation: All admitted gateway telemetry is healthy: checkout span OK at 63ms, error_rate 0.0012, p95 75ms, zero dependency timeouts and db pool waiters, INFO 200 logs. This contradicts the alert and supports no bounded root-cause candidate. Downstream services in the topology have no observations, so the fault cannot be localized; hand off for broader telemetry.
missing_evidence: Current telemetry for order, payment, inventory, redis, and postgresql services (traces, metrics, logs) to locate any real fault
Gateway error-rate and latency time series covering the alert window to confirm whether the alert condition is present
Evidence of dependency timeouts, db pool waiters, or 5xx responses on any service in the checkout path
